title: Unlocking Materials Discovery: A Comprehensive Guide to High-Throughput Experimental Databases
description: This article explores High-Throughput Experimental Materials (HTEM) Databases, powerful resources transforming materials science by providing large-scale, publicly accessible experimental data. It covers foundational concepts, data access methodologies, challenges in data veracity and standardization, and their integration with computational efforts to accelerate materials-driven innovation.
audience: researchers, scientists, and drug development professionals
